context.question: For Union Pacific Corporation and subsidiaries in fiscal year 2015, what percentage of total operating revenues was total freight revenues? Report to six decimal places and cite the actual calculation support.

relation_sum.rule: Two nonoverlapping exhaustive members of the supplied part-whole relation, in either order, with identical subject/period/scope/currency/unit. Produces their total. Relation evidence must be explicitly selected.

scale_percent.rule: One previously accepted share_ratio, multiply by 100; output percent.

share_ratio.rule: A source member divided by its legitimate total, disclosed or previously accepted relation_sum; matching contextual units, nonzero denominator.
